panel.note: The Day rendition's enamel ground, carrying a 6px radial speckle at 13% ink.

ink.note: Each rendition owns exactly one dark ink; on light renditions --ink and --ink-dark are the same value.

ink-dark.note: The one dark ink used on white prints. On slate it is #232120, on night #0d1836, on porcelain #1b1f22.

accent.note: Means 'not seen by you yet' and nothing else. Solved twice per rendition: --accent-on-panel and --accent-on-print.

accent-on-panel.note: On a light panel the accent pulls down toward the ink; on the dark renditions it pulls up toward the light instead.

accent-on-print.note: The correction for an accent marker sitting on a white print. Also the caret colour.

rule.note: Top bar bottom edge and switcher border.

panel-sunk.note: Recessed ground behind an opened fan, inside the switcher well, and under a loading image.

chip-black.note: Rendition-independent. Only where a label sits on an arbitrary photograph, or inside the video transport.

figure.purpose: The day number in the spine. Quantities are the interface: in a pile, '212 photos' is the most useful fact on the screen.

display.purpose: The single lede on sign-in and the empty state. Capped at 24ch.

headline.purpose: The day's item count, in tabular figures under a 2px rule.

title.purpose: Instance name in the top bar, index card titles, the frame count on a stack.

body.purpose: Everything read as language. Comment bodies and prose cap at 62ch, definition bodies at 68ch.

label.purpose: Archivo Narrow tracked caps for month names, section headings, the unseen marker, and switcher chips.

shadows.name: print-contact
shadows.value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, #1b1f22 22%, transparent), 0 4px 10px -4px color-mix(in oklab, #1b1f22 18%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Prints and anchored Mantine paper popovers (theme shadow sm). Structural contact depth.

shadows.name: flat-contact
shadows.purpose: Prints under a stack, burst sibling thumbnails, the comments panel, index cards.

shadows.name: frame-contact
shadows.value: 0 2px 4px color-mix(in oklab, #1b1f22 20%, transparent), 0 12px 28px -12px color-mix(in oklab, #1b1f22 28%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: The single large item frame in the viewer.

shadows.name: card-contact
shadows.value: 0 2px 4px color-mix(in oklab, #1b1f22 20%, transparent), 0 14px 30px -14px color-mix(in oklab, #1b1f22 30%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: The sign-in card, the one surface that floats on an otherwise empty panel.

shadows.name: marker-halo
shadows.purpose: A 2px white ring keeping the unseen dot legible over an arbitrary photograph. A ring, not a shadow.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Every focusable element, system-wide. Accented because it is a browser surface, not page chrome.

motion.name: fan-open
motion.value: animation: fan 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px) scale(0.985) }
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: a stack fans open. Nothing else animates in.

motion.name: print-lift
motion.purpose: A print rises 2px on hover. Enhancement only; nothing depends on hover.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All motion is optional. The reduced-motion override is total.

themes.name: day
themes.note: Default. Pale blue panel, navy ink.

themes.name: messy
themes.note: Default pile arrangement. An instance-level setting in the product, not a per-viewer preference.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid ink on print. The only primary action treatment; it never carries the accent.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.375rem; border: 1px solid var(--ink-dark, #12235e); border-radius: 0; background: var(--ink-dark, #12235e); color: var(--print, #fbfcfe); font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink-dark, #12235e) 82%, var(--print, #fbfcfe)); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink-dark, #12235e) 82%, var(--print, #fbfcfe)); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-on-panel, #9e2f1b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { background: transparent; border-color: var(--rule-strong, #7482be); color: var(--on-print-quiet, #4a5ca7); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Quiet Button

components.name: Switcher Chips
components.description: A sunk well of tracked label caps. The pressed chip inverts to solid ink, never the accent.
components.css: .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; background: var(--panel-sunk, #bccbe5); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #8792bd); } .ds-switch button { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.875rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #12235e); font-family: "Archivo Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch button:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink, #12235e) 12%, transparent); } .ds-switch button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink, #12235e); color: var(--panel, #c9d6ed); } .ds-switch button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-on-panel, #9e2f1b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Print
components.description: A photograph stuck flat on the panel: 5px of white paper, a contact shadow, a seeded tilt, and the accent dot when unseen. No card shell, no radius, no crop.
components.css: .ds-print { position: relative; display: block; width: 9.5rem; padding: 5px; border-radius: 0; background: var(--print, #fbfcfe); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, #1b1f22 22%, transparent), 0 4px 10px -4px color-mix(in oklab, #1b1f22 18%, transparent); cursor: pointer; transform: rotate(var(--r, 0deg)) translate(var(--dx, 0px), var(--dy, 0px)) scale(1.03); transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-print img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; background: var(--panel-sunk, #bccbe5); } .ds-print:hover { transform: rotate(var(--r, 0deg)) translate(var(--dx, 0px), var(--dy, 0px)) scale(1.07); z-index: 20; } .ds-print:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-on-panel, #9e2f1b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-print-unseen { position: absolute; z-index: 2; top: 10px; right: 10px; width: 0.7rem; height: 0.7rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent-on-panel, #9e2f1b); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--print, #fbfcfe); }

components.name: Burst Stack
components.description: The signature component. Forty near-identical frames are one object: a print with two offset, tilted prints behind it and a tabular frame count. It fans open in place rather than taking you elsewhere.

components.css: .ds-stack { position: relative; width: 9.5rem; } .ds-stack::before, .ds-stack::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--print, #fbfcfe); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, #1b1f22 20%, transparent); } .ds-stack::before { transform: translate(10px, 7px) rotate(1.1deg); } .ds-stack::after { transform: translate(5px, 3px) rotate(-0.6deg); } .ds-stack-face { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: block; width: 100%; padding: 5px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--print, #fbfcfe); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, #1b1f22 22%, transparent), 0 4px 10px -4px color-mix(in oklab, #1b1f22 18%, transparent); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transform: rotate(-0.8deg) scale(1.02); } .ds-stack-face img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; } .ds-stack-face:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-on-panel, #9e2f1b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-stack-count { position: absolute; z-index: 30; right: 10px; bottom: 10px; display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.3rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem; background: #1b1f22; color: #ffffff; font-family: "Familjen Grotesk", Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stack-count small { font-family: "Archivo Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Date Spine

components.css: .ds-spine { width: 13rem; padding-bottom: 3.5rem; color: var(--ink, #12235e); } .ds-spine-figure { margin: 0; font-family: "Familjen Grotesk", Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 5vw, 4rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 0.85; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-spine-month { margin: 0.15rem 0 0; color: var(--on-panel-quiet, #45599f); font-family: "Archivo Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-spine-count { margin: 0.875rem 0 0; padding-top: 0.875rem; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink, #12235e); font-family: "Familjen Grotesk", Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 1.625rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-spine-count span { color: var(--on-panel-quiet, #45599f); font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-unseen { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; margin: 0.875rem 0 0; color: var(--accent-on-panel, #9e2f1b); font-family: "Archivo Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-unseen::before { content: ""; width: 0.7rem; height: 0.7rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent-on-panel, #9e2f1b); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Print ground, structural hairline, zero radius, 3rem tall. The invalid state is carried by border weight, an icon and bold type, never by hue.
components.html: That code has four digits.

components.name: Jump Rail
components.description: One control that moves the whole field. A real native select with the OS chrome replaced by this world's edge and an authored caret; the element and its behaviour are untouched, because the audience skews older.

components.name: Note with Timestamp Stamp

Abuela

components.css: .ds-talk { padding: 1.375rem; background: var(--print, #fbfcfe); color: var(--ink-dark, #12235e); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, #1b1f22 20%, transparent); font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; } .ds-note { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 0.3rem 0.875rem; padding-block: 1.375rem; } .ds-note-who { font-weight: 600; } .ds-note-body { grid-column: 1 / -1; max-width: 62ch; margin: 0; } .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-self: start; gap: 0.35rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--ink-dark, #12235e); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-dark, #12235e); font-family: "Familjen Grotesk", Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; } .ds-stamp svg { width: 0.85rem; height: 0.85rem; fill: currentColor; } .ds-stamp:hover { background: var(--ink-dark, #12235e); color: var(--print, #fbfcfe); } .ds-stamp:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-on-panel, #9e2f1b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Video Transport
components.description: An opaque bar under the frame: square play button, tabular clock, and a measured scrubber whose ticks let a pinned note stand at a readable place. The played bar is print white, not accent.
components.html: 0:06 / 0:22
components.css: .ds-transport { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.875rem; padding: 0.875rem; background: #1b1f22; color: #ffffff; } .ds-transport-play { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: none; width: 3rem; height: 3rem; padding: 0; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, #ffffff 45%, #1b1f22); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; } .ds-transport-play svg { width: 1.15rem; height: 1.15rem; fill: currentColor; } .ds-transport-play:hover { background: var(--print, #fbfcfe); border-color: var(--print, #fbfcfe); color: #1b1f22; } .ds-transport-play:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-on-panel, #9e2f1b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-transport-clock { font-family: "Familjen Grotesk", Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-scrubber { position: relative; flex: 1; height: 3rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-scrubber-rules { position: absolute; inset: 50% 0 auto; height: 9px; transform: translateY(-50%); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to right, color-mix(in oklab, #ffffff 40%, #1b1f22) 0 1px, transparent 1px 10%); } .ds-scrubber-track { position: absolute; inset: 50% 0 auto; height: 3px; transform: translateY(-50%); background: color-mix(in oklab, #ffffff 26%, #1b1f22); } .ds-scrubber-played { position: absolute; inset: 50% auto auto 0; width: 27%; height: 3px; transform: translateY(-50%); background: var(--print, #fbfcfe); } .ds-scrubber-mark { position: absolute; top: 50%; width: 3px; height: 22px; margin-left: -1.5px; padding: 0; transform: translateY(-50%); border: 0; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; } .ds-scrubber-mark::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -11px -21px; } .ds-scrubber-mark:hover, .ds-scrubber-mark:focus-visible { background: var(--print, #fbfcfe); height: 30px; }

components.css: .ds-moment { background: var(--print, #fbfcfe); color: var(--on-print, #12235e); padding: var(--sp-2, 0.875rem); border: 1px solid var(--rule-print, color-mix(in oklab, #12235e 16%, #fbfcfe)); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: var(--shadow-print, 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, #1b1f22 22%, transparent)); font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; width: min(22rem, 100%); } .ds-moment header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-moment button { background: transparent; color: inherit; border: 0; min-height: 3rem; min-width: 3rem; font: inherit; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; } .ds-moment button:hover { background: var(--print-sunk, color-mix(in oklab, #12235e 6%, #fbfcfe)); } .ds-moment button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-moment p { font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0.5rem 0 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

narrative.overview:
An uncurated family archive is a refrigerator door, not a gallery. Things get stuck up without anyone deciding, they accumulate, they overlap, and nobody composed the result. The whole system is one enamelled domestic panel with prints stuck flat on it: a fine speckled ground, thin white print borders, a date spine down the left that never scrolls away, and exactly one saturated accent that means "you have not seen this yet" and nothing else.

The load-bearing idea is the stack. A burst of forty near-identical frames is one object you fan out in place, not forty tiles burying the rest of the day. Nothing is cropped to a square, ever: cover-cropping a family archive cuts faces out of it, so every print claims the height its own proportions need and the pile is a multi-column flow that packs flush around them. The default arrangement is messy: prints go up crooked and overlapping, seeded from each print's index so the wall is stable across reloads rather than jittering on every paint.

This world defines itself against two things it will not do. It refuses the justified square grid under floating translucent date headers that every photo cloud ships, and it refuses the precious dark curated gallery. There is no backdrop-filter anywhere, no card shell around a photograph, and no decorative drop shadow. Type is large by default because the audience skews older and is mostly on phones: nothing in the ramp is under 15px, every tap target clears 3rem (48px), and nothing depends on hover, long-press, or precise dragging.

The system was derived from throwaway prototypes in prototypes/, which will be deleted once the real app is built. A future reader should expect that directory to be gone; the tokens, not the prototype, are the record.
keyCharacteristics: Four closed palettes, four inks each, every other value a color-mix of those four. Day (pale blue panel, navy ink) is the default.
One accent, one meaning: unseen. Focus ring and caret only, as browser surfaces.
Square-cornered surfaces; semantic curves identify labels, switches, radio controls, unseen dots and timeline identities.
Prints, not cards: a white border and a contact shadow, no shell.
Multi-column pile, no cropping, no square tiles, no justified rows.
Tabular numerals on every count, every clock, every code field.
Opaque chrome at every width; no translucency, no backdrop-filter.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: The accent means "not seen by you yet" and nothing else. Switcher chips, primary buttons, pinned-note stamps, the played bar, and error text all carry ink instead. The focus ring and the text caret are the only other accented things, and they are accented because they are browser surfaces rather than page chrome.

rules.name: The Four Inks Rule
rules.body: A rendition declares exactly four inks: panel, print, ink, accent. Every other colour in that rendition is a color-mix(in oklab, ...) of those four. A fifth hand-picked colour is a bug, and a second near-black was one that got fixed.

rules.name: The Two Accents Rule
rules.body: Every rendition solves its accent twice, once for the panel and once for a white print. Never reuse --accent-on-panel on a print, or the reverse.

rules.name: The Not-By-Hue Rule
rules.body: No state is carried by hue alone. An invalid field gets a 2px ink border, a bold label, and an icon; it does not get red.

rules.name: The Fifteen Pixel Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing in this system is set below 0.9375rem (15px), and body text starts at 1.125rem (18px). The audience skews older and browses on phones; AA's minimum is not the floor here.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change carries font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums: day counts, frame counts, the video clock, the pinned timestamp, the six-digit code field. Counts must not shuffle sideways as they tick.

rules.name: The In-Flow Spine Rule
rules.body: The date spine is opaque and in flow at every width. A translucent floating date header is the exact pattern this world refuses, and shipping one at phone width is a regression, not a responsive adaptation.

rules.name: The No-Crop Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the pile is cropped to a square. Every print keeps its intrinsic ratio at whatever height it needs. The only object-fit: cover in the system is on the 4.25rem burst-sibling thumbnails in the item viewer, where the frames are near-identical by definition.

rules.name: The Paper-On-Panel Rule
rules.body: A shadow describes paper resting above its ground: prints, frames, the sign-in card, and anchored paper popovers. Persistent chrome, buttons, chips and inputs are flat. Timeline emoji edge shadows only aid contrast over moving video.

rules.name: The Opaque Chrome Rule
rules.body: The top bar and the date spine are opaque (background: var(--panel)). No backdrop-filter, no translucent floating layer, anywhere, at any width. Translucent floating chrome is the pattern this direction defines itself against.

dos: Do derive every new colour as a color-mix(in oklab, ...) of the rendition's four inks. If a value cannot be expressed that way, the design is wrong, not the palette.
Do solve the accent twice for any new rendition: --accent-on-panel and --accent-on-print pull in opposite directions on a dark panel.
Do keep every interactive target at 3rem (48px) minimum height, and give any small hit area an invisible 44x44 pointer target the way the scrubber marks do.
Do put font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every figure that can change.
Do let prints keep their intrinsic proportions and let the multi-column pile pack around them.
Do seed any tilt, offset, or z-order from the item's index so the wall is identical on every reload.
Do treat the pile arrangement (tidy / messy) as an instance-level setting: one wall for everybody in the circle, not a per-viewer preference.
Do carry state in weight, border thickness, icon, and case as well as in colour.
donts: Don't use the accent for anything except "not seen by you yet". Not for a primary button, a selected chip, a played bar, an error, a link, or a brand flourish. Focus ring and caret are the only exceptions, and only because they are browser surfaces.
Don't add backdrop-filter, translucency, or a floating chrome layer anywhere, at any width.
Don't crop a photograph to a square, and don't render an opened burst as a uniform grid of tiles.
Do not add decorative shadows. Contact shadows belong to paper surfaces and anchored popovers; timeline emoji edge shadows aid contrast.
Do not introduce decorative corner radii. Keep surfaces square and curves reserved for the documented semantic shapes, including timeline identities.
Don't introduce a fifth colour, a second dark ink per rendition, or a grey that is not a mix of the rendition's own inks.
Don't replace the native <select> with an invented menu, or build any interaction that needs hover, long-press, precise dragging, or a gesture the user has to discover.
Don't add handwriting faces, tape, pushpin, or paper-texture ornament. The fridge door is the structure, not a skin.
